semantic_summary: 2026 UK ETS conversion factors, MRV guidance and reporting tools are authoritative accounting inputs but are not observations without compatible activity data and verified installation scope.

Environment Agency landfill methane research and landfill surface-flux guidance provide method and regulatory context; a parcel claim still requires an explicit measured result, unit, period, uncertainty and geometry.
Incinerator annual monitoring reports are a high-value measurement candidate surface, but report-level rows have not yet been extracted, unit-normalised and parcel-bound.
MCERTS/CEMS/periodic stack-monitoring standards establish method quality and uncertainty controls rather than the measured value itself.
Permit, BAT, PC/PEC risk-screening, decarbonisation-readiness and CCS guidance remain regulatory or modelling evidence and cannot be promoted directly to measured parcel GHG.
No browser acceptance, parcel binding, database write, migration or deployment was executed.
